t: This is the International Memorial to Seafarers, at the International Maritime Organization. It was made by Michael Sandle, a British sculptor and artist born in 1936. Sandle has made several public sculptures, and many of them relate to themes of war, death or destruction. That gives you a sense of the seriousness he brings to a memorial like this one. Take a moment to look at it and think of the seafarers it honours.
